steps.title: Your Blackboard Learn site
instructions: You need a Blackboard Learn administrator to complete the connection.
One Learn site is one connection. Enter the address that teachers use.

steps.title: Register Cogniate in Blackboard Learn
instructions: In Learn, open Administrator Panel, then LTI Tool Providers, then Register LTI 1.3/Advantage Tool.
Enter the Client ID below and submit. Compare the values that Learn shows with the rows below.
Set User Fields to Send to Role in Course only. Do not send Name or Email Address.
Allow grade service access and Membership Service access. Set the Tool Status to Approved.
Copy the Deployment ID that Learn shows.

steps.title: Save the Blackboard values
instructions: Ask your Cogniate operator for an approval code. The operator checks the request with your Blackboard administrator first. The code works once and expires.

steps.title: Add a Cogniate course in Blackboard
instructions: Blackboard Ultra: open Course Content, then select +, then Content Market, then Cogniate. Select the course.
Blackboard Original: open a content area, then Build Content, then Cogniate. Select the course.
A learner must open the activity from Blackboard. Learners are anonymous: Cogniate gets no names or emails.
